title: Tower Fusion Guide for Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD
subtitle: How to merge two elemental towers into one, which six fusions exist and when it is worth it.
description: How does tower fusion work in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD? Rules, all six fusion towers, what carries over, and when merging two towers is worth the cost.
card: How fusion works in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD, the rules, all six fusion towers, what carries over and when merging two towers is worth it.

faq.q: How do I fuse towers in Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD?
faq.a: Put two towers of different elements on neighbouring slots and upgrade each to at least 3 total stat levels. Then merge them. You get one fusion tower and the second slot becomes free again.

faq.q: What carries over when two towers fuse?
faq.a: Half of the combined stat levels and half of the combined gold invested carry over to the new tower. Nothing is refunded for the second tower, so fuse towers you have upgraded for a reason.

faq.q: Can a fusion tower be fused again?
faq.a: No. Only towers that are not already fusions can be merged. A fusion tower is final, but you can keep upgrading its stats and reinforce it once all six stats are maxed.
